# Isapur Industrial Park

> Industrial plots on Hapur-Modinagar Road, Yusufpur Isapur, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh. Plots from 300 sq yards. 50 ft wide RCC roads, street lighting, planted greenery. 4.7 km by road (about 8 minutes) to the Delhi-Meerut Expressway on-ramp at Bhojpur.

Contact: 98370 57800, 92195 49800. Address: Hapur-Modinagar Road, Yusufpur Isapur, Ghaziabad, UP 201022.
